analyst.summary: Sharda Cropchem's debt-free, asset-light agrochemical distribution model is showing a genuine recovery -- both revenue growth (~37% in the latest quarter) and margins have improved meaningfully after a rough 2022-24 period that hit the broader agrochemical sector through channel destocking. Returns on capital have also stepped up recently (ROE ~23% versus a 13% three-year average). At around 12x earnings, the stock looks statistically cheap, though investors should recognize this is a cyclical, competitively priced generics business rather than assume the current growth rate is a new permanent run-rate.
